Frequently Asked Questions by Laboratory Owners

Does Aarozi Healthcare work without an internet connection?

Yes. Aarozi is built offline-first. Patient registration, billing, barcode printing, analyzer data ingestion, and report verification all run on your local master PC. An internet connection is only needed during initial license download or optional cloud backup.

How do multiple computers connect in my lab?

Your main computer runs the Aarozi server. All other computers (reception, doctor desk, phlebotomy) simply open Chrome or Edge and enter the server's local IP address (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8000). You do NOT need to buy separate licenses for each workstation.

What happens to our patient data if our subscription expires?

Your patient records and financial data are never deleted or locked. If a yearly subscription expires past its 30-day grace period, the system enters a read-only mode where you can view, print, search, and export all historical records indefinitely until you choose to renew.

What if my server computer's hard drive crashes?

You can restore your database instantly from your daily external USB backup. You can transfer your commercial license to a new PC up to twice per year directly from your online Customer Portal.
